ab_test.read: Half A answered at 1.92% and half B at 1.3% (z = 2.46, past the 1.96 line), so the urgency headline beat the general one on the same offer and the same day.

repeat_call.offer_to_repeat: a free item with the purchase
repeat_call.offer_evidence: On the same station and daypart, the free-item offer (buy 3 mums, get the 4th free) cost 26.42 per response against 44.21 for 20% off bulbs. The flights ran in different weeks, so this is a lead to follow, not a controlled result.
repeat_call.line_to_repeat: an urgency headline: get there before the best ones are gone
repeat_call.line_evidence: Half A answered at 1.92% and half B at 1.3% (z = 2.46, past the 1.96 line), so the urgency headline beat the general one on the same offer and the same day.
fix_before_repeating: The podcast drew 17 code orders, under the 20 floor: run it again only with a code said twice and its own path.
The billboard had no code and no number, so its 212 sessions are interest only: give the new board a code.

Every code kept redeeming after its window (fall26-radio-sep 4, fall26-radio-oct 3, fall26-mail-a 2, fall26-mail-b 1, fall26-podcast 2); those orders are left out, and the new codes expire when pre-orders close.

script.text: Boots on frosty gravel, a car door closes.
Our best Fraser firs usually sell out the first weekend after Thanksgiving.
So this year, pick yours first. Pre-order a fresh-cut tree at quillfern dot example, choose your pickup day, and we'll net it and load it for you.
Use code PINE for a free tree stand. That's code PINE, at quillfern dot example.
Quillfern Garden Center. Pre-orders close December first.
Our best Fraser firs usually go the first weekend after Thanksgiving. Pre-order yours at quillfern dot example with code SPRUCE and get a free tree stand. Pre-orders close December first.

required_lines.text: This episode is sponsored by Quillfern Garden Center.
Pre-order a fresh-cut tree at quillfern dot example slash listen, use code TINSEL, and get a free tree stand.
That's code TINSEL at quillfern dot example slash listen. Pre-orders close December first.

talking_points: Our premium Fraser firs usually sell out the first weekend after Thanksgiving.
Pre-ordered trees are netted and loaded onto your car at pickup.
Pickup runs from November 28 to December 20.
Only if it is true for the host: their own experience picking up a tree at Quillfern. Leave it out otherwise.
pieces.sample_full_read: This episode is sponsored by Quillfern Garden Center. If you've ever shown up the weekend after Thanksgiving and found the good trees gone, this one's for you. Quillfern's premium Fraser firs usually sell out that first weekend. This year you can skip the hunt. Pre-order a fresh-cut tree at quillfern dot example slash listen, use code TINSEL, and get a free tree stand. You pick a pickup day between November twenty-eighth and December twentieth, and they net the tree and load it onto your car. That's code TINSEL at quillfern dot example slash listen. Pre-orders close December first.
pieces.disclosure: spoken in the first line, before any recommendation

pieces.size_note: EDDM Retail takes flats only: a piece qualifies when it is longer than 10.5 in, higher than 6.125 in or thicker than 0.25 in. 6 x 9 in meets none of these, so it would be refused at the counter; 6.25 x 9 in qualifies on height. Confirm with the print vendor before artwork.

front.headline: The best trees go first.
front.subline: Pre-order yours now. Free tree stand with code FIRSTPICK.
front.image: A netted Fraser fir strapped to a car roof at the store gate, string lights behind, early evening.

back.headline: Pick first. Pick it up when you're ready.
back.body: Choose your tree online, pick a pickup day between November 28 and December 20, and we'll net it and load it onto your car.
back.offer_box: Free tree stand with any pre-ordered tree. Code FIRSTPICK. Pre-orders close December 1.
back.response: Scan the QR code, visit quillfern.example/m or call 555-0142.
back.address_side: Keep the address block and barcode clear zone your print vendor's EDDM template marks; the offer box sits beside it.

pieces.qr: at least 0.8 in (2 cm) square with a clear margin of 4 modules, printed on the back beside the offer box
